entries.source: E. Curzel and G. M. Varanini (eds.), Codex Wangianus. I cartulari della Chiesa trentina, Bologna 2007; Document 48*; also Tiroler Urkundenbuch, series I, vol. 3, no. 1079
entries.english: At Bolzano, Bertold of Taranto, acting in an imperial capacity, fixes a hearing date in a legal dispute concerning the parties from Nago and their representatives. Friedrich von Rosenberg appears among the witnesses.

facts.subject: Friedrich de Rosenbach
facts.content: appears among the witnesses to the proceeding.
